comments.body: `Promise.all` was replaced with `promiseAll`, but this file has no import of it. The diff adds no import here, and a grep of the file finds only the call at line 37. In the same diff, `packages/medusa/src/subscribers/order.js` is a plain JS module, so `tsc` does not check it. When this subscriber handles an order event, `await promiseAll(order.discounts.map(...))` throws `ReferenceError: promiseAll is not defined`. The discount `usage_count` update never runs, so usage counts stop incrementing after an order is placed. Add `import { promiseAll } from "@medusajs/utils"`, or use `require` if the file is CommonJS.
